body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"siainbuletin"} -->
_Requested by **Sia** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2?thread=cmsg_01KaQfLZaF43QUMN3kcT7pW2PiRgUpwtn9KJao7HrRaDbb)_

## Summary
One doc, `docs/tangles/custom/sp-search-browsing-trails.org`, replaces `sp-search.org`, `sp-browsing.org` and `sp-trails.org`.

- A comparison table of the three modules is at the top (goal, loading, search, capture, trail recording, browser integration, keys, commands, packages, programs, storage, customization, status), plus a short list of overlaps, for you to restructure from.
- The three old docs are kept whole as top-level parts (headings one level down, text and code unchanged), the same pattern as `sp-vulpea.org`: each part sets its `:tangle` path in a `:header-args:emacs-lisp+:` property.
- Tangling: `sp-search.el` and `sp-browsing.el` are still tangled from the doc, as two files. The emacs-lisp blocks of both parts are identical to the old docs (26 and 20 blocks, checked by script), so the `.el` files do not change.
- `sp-trails.el` was never tangled (the old doc was a problem statement). I did not move its code in; that is a separate step.
- Links to the old docs (README, CHANGELOG, `sp-fetch-academic`, `sp-tab-psearch`, `VENDORED.org`) point to the new file. The file name is my choice and is easy to rename.

## Conflict with #217
#217 edits `sp-search.org` (3 lines in the menu block) and the README, so whichever of the two merges second has to be adjusted: apply the `j` menu entry of #217 to the `sp-search.el` part of the new doc (the `.el` change in #217 is then already tangled). #217 also adds `sp-trails-search.org`, which links to `sp-trails.org`; that link needs the new name. If this PR goes first, rebase #217; if #217 goes first, rebase this one.

## Test plan
- [x] Emacs-lisp blocks of the new parts equal those of the old docs (script comparison); tangle targets resolve to the same two `.el` files.
- [ ] CI tangle check (Emacs is not available in the container).
- [ ] Open the doc in Emacs: the table renders and the part headings fold.

---
